entities.summary: Leszek Władysław Lubicz-Nycz was a Polish fencer. He won a bronze medal in the team sabre event at the 1932 Summer Olympics. Lubicz-Nycz served in the Polish Army between 1918 and his death in 1939. He was killed in action near Warsaw during the September Campaign.
